Verdict

No confirmed malicious supply-chain compromise indicators. Overall risk: **info**

Malicious Supply-Chain Indicators

No confirmed malicious supply-chain indicators.

Automatic Execution Paths

  • In the provided extracted corpus, there is no evidence of .pth, sitecustomize.py, usercustomize.py, malicious install-time setup.py logic, PEP 517 build-hook abuse, or import-time payload execution.
  • The observed CLI and service-management behavior appears user-triggered. Normal console_scripts-style execution is not evidence of malicious automatic execution during installation or Python interpreter startup.

Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Stealth

  • **Credential harvesting:** No evidence was found of broad collection of environment variables, .env files, SSH keys, cloud credentials, CI/CD tokens, wallet files, or similar secrets in the provided corpus.
  • **Exfiltration/staging:** No evidence was found of archiving/staging harvested files or uploading them to attacker-controlled endpoints.
  • **Persistence:** afkbot/services/managed_runtime_service.py contains systemd/launchd service creation and start logic. However, the names and markers align with an AFKBOT managed runtime service, and the behavior appears to be a documented/user-invoked background-service feature such as afk service start/install. There is no evidence that persistence is installed automatically at package install time or used as a hidden backdoor.
  • **Lateral movement:** No evidence was found of Kubernetes, Docker socket, cloud metadata, GitHub Actions/CI token theft, or workflow injection.
  • **Obfuscation/loader:** No evidence was found of eval/exec, base64/zlib/marshal staged loaders, encrypted payloads, or self-deleting droppers. Pre-scan hits involving regexes or the cryptography dependency appear consistent with ordinary application functionality and are insufficient as malicious loader evidence.

Distribution Integrity Anomalies

  • Based on the provided input, hidden payloads, unexplained native binaries, sdist/wheel mismatches, or differences from the source repository could not be confirmed.
  • Network strings such as raw.githubusercontent.com, afkbot.io/install.sh, and LLM/API provider domains appear related to documentation, installer instructions, or normal application/API marketplace functionality, not confirmed malicious supply-chain exfiltration.

Additional Verification Needed

  • Only selected text from a subset of the 800 extracted files was provided. Full review of automatic-execution files such as .pth, sitecustomize.py, setup.py, pyproject.toml build backend configuration, and any large/binary files is still needed.
  • Compare the PyPI sdist with the public GitHub source, check for any wheel-vs-sdist differences if a wheel exists, and review release-to-release dependency changes.
